# Plan: Task Tracker API

<!-- Generated by wave-plan from docs/waves/specs/*.md. The specs own the "what" (depends_on,
     owns, acceptance criteria); this file owns the "when and how". Do not restate spec fields
     freehand: edit the spec and regenerate. Machine-readable data lives only in the fenced
     blocks below (flow-style YAML, one line per field); everything else is for humans. -->

## Header

```yaml header
design: none
bootstrap: "uv sync && echo DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:pass@localhost:5432/taskdb > .env && echo REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0 >> .env"
gates: {format: "uv run ruff format --check .", lint: "uv run ruff check .", unit: "sh -c 'uv run pytest tests/ -q; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 5 ] || exit $rc'"}
max_wave_width: 8
```

Prerequisites the plan assumes are already running on the host: Postgres container `pg` on 5432 (database `taskdb`, user `postgres`, password `pass`) and a Redis container `redis` on 6379 (`docker run -d --name redis -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine`). Everything else is created by the plan.
